behavior: Every GenCon Client Billing automatically has one corresponding Subcontractor Billing row.
Existing GenCon rows are backfilled by SQL; no manual re-encoding of row structure.
Subcon row values remain manual: subcontractor, billing amount, retention, recoupment, then Add Issued Amount.
Subcon Billing % = Subcon Billing Amount / Subcon Contract Amount x 100.
Retention and Recoupment amounts are calculated from each Subcon billing amount.
Budget Monitoring gets the detailed live Subcon Billing report and remaining contract balance.
Old linked Subcon allocation panel is hidden but its stored data is not deleted.
after_upload: Run v28.19-auto-subcon-mirror.sql once in Supabase SQL Editor.
The release gate will refresh other open accounts.
